details: A cost ceiling that overshoots spends the owner's money past the number they set.
failing_case: `--max-cost-usd 4` at `-j 4` ran to $6.32 (Sonnet measure, 22 Oct); the README's $10 ceiling can reach about $13; should stop within one batch of the ceiling (handover "ceiling overshoot", "eval cost ceiling not firm at -j 4", check-readme-cost "$10 ceiling worst case ~$13")
reason: tests/test_paid_cost_limits.py:28 (cap 4, -j 4, largest run 0.80 gives ceiling 1.6), :32 falls back to -j 1; CiWiring test checks bin/ci uses it. Fails without the fix.
findings.summary: A run goes past its money limit when run in parallel
